svg.aria-label: Four nodes process the same 24 units, four slices of six groups of dataset steps. A processes a unit in one time unit, B and C in two, D in four. With a fixed split each node owns one slice of every step: A finishes its six units at t = 6, B and C at t = 12, and D works alone until t = 24. With a shared queue each node claims the next unclaimed unit when it is ready: A processes 11 units, B and C 5 each and D 3, and all are done at t = 12.
svg.text: a unit processed by A, B, C or D: A takes 1 time unit, B and C take 2, D takes 4
Each node owns one slice of every step.
Each node claims the next unclaimed unit.
Units are equal in size; loading and claiming them take no time here.
